title: TAROT SCHOOL:
THE FOUR SUITS EXPLAINED
script: Cups invite you to notice feelings and relationships.
Wands point to energy, creativity and action.
Swords ask you to examine thoughts, choices and conflict.
Pentacles bring you back to everyday life: work, money and practical priorities.
Together, they're four different lenses for understanding what's happening in your life.
Once you learn the suits, reading tarot starts to feel much less mysterious.
Save this for your next reading.
